They explicitly check if nodes are leaves or internal nodes (varying depths) and recursively process faces and edges to generate the mesh, rather than simply placing a vertex at every leaf node. Source [S2] specifically notes that for internal nodes, it recursively processes children and then iterates over faces and edges, calling recursive procedures for those structures.
